struck: The households arriving reported about 2.5 times the income of the households leaving.
use: In total, about $1.25 billion of income arrived and about $505 million left; per household, the households moving in reported about 1.5 times the income of those moving out, on average.

struck: Few households go back the other way.
use: Few households go back to the New York and New Jersey counties. North Carolina counties trade households both ways.

struck: Most people who leave Horry County do not go far.
use: The top destinations for households that leave Horry County are nearby: Georgetown County, SC, Brunswick County, NC, and Charleston County, SC. About one in four households that leave go to another South Carolina county.

struck: The income of households moving in has risen. In the earliest of the five IRS years they reported about $68,000 each; in the latest, about $83,000.
use: (cut it: it crosses the IRS series break and is not adjusted for inflation)

struck: Over the five years since the 2020 census, no metro area in the country grew faster in percent terms.
use: Since the 2020 census the Myrtle Beach metro grew about 22 percent, one of the two fastest of the country's 387 metro areas, with The Villages, Florida.

pattern: \bin the counties that send the most movers[^.]{0,40}\bhigher\b
struck: In the counties that send the most movers it is higher.
use: In most of the out-of-state counties that send the most movers it is higher.

struck: Of the about 3,700 houses for sale on the Grand Strand now ...
use: Of the about 3,700 houses for sale in our MLS area now (Horry and Georgetown counties and nearby parts of South Carolina and North Carolina) ...

struck: Property tax here runs near 0.38 percent of value.
use: Property tax on one $400,000 house in unincorporated Horry County is about $1,470 a year if you live in it, and about $4,820 if it is a second home or a rental.

struck: At 65, the first $50,000 of your home's value is exempt from property tax, once you have lived in South Carolina for a year.
use: At 65, the first $50,000 of your home's value is exempt from property tax once you have lived in South Carolina for a year; for 2026 only, an owner who already qualified in 2025 gets $75,000.

struck: Making friends is harder near the city core, where much of the population is tourists or seasonal and leaves.
use: Making friends is harder than movers expect, because many people near the city core are tourists or a seasonal population that leaves.

struck: Hurricane season is June through November, and most storms come between mid-August and mid-October.
use: Hurricane season is June through November, and across the Atlantic most activity comes between mid-August and mid-October.

struck: Owners on active duty in the military do not pay it.
use: Owners on active duty in the military, and their spouses and dependents, do not pay it.
